question: Which Indian classical dance is shown in the sculptures at the ancient Konark Sun Temple?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odissi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Odissi is one of the oldest surviving Indian classical dance forms, originating from the state of Odisha.
 
• The sculptures at the ancient Konark Sun Temple prominently depict Odissi dance poses, showcasing its deep connection with temple art.
 
• The dance is characterized by fluid movements, intricate footwork, and expressive gestures, all inspired by the Natya Shastra.
 
• Odissi was traditionally performed in temples as part of religious rituals and is deeply rooted in devotional themes, especially related to Lord Jagannath.
 
• The Konark Sun Temple, built in the 13th century, is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and its carvings serve as a visual archive of Odissi dance postures.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Natya Shastra**

 
 
• Natya Shastra is an ancient Sanskrit text written by Bharata, which serves as the foundational treatise for Indian classical dances.
 
• The text outlines the techniques of performance, including gestures (Mudras), expressions (Bhavas), and rhythmic movements.
 
• Odissi is one of the dances that strictly adheres to the principles of Natya Shastra.
 
 
 
• **Konark Sun Temple**
 
 
• Located in Odisha, the Konark Sun Temple was constructed in the 13th century by King Narasimhadeva I of the Eastern Ganga dynasty.
 
• The temple is designed in the shape of a colossal chariot dedicated to the Sun God.
 
• The intricate carvings on the temple walls depict various aspects of daily life, music, dance, and spirituality.
 
 
 
• **UNESCO World Heritage Site**
 
 
• The Konark Sun Temple was designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1984.
 
• The site is renowned for its architectural brilliance and historical significance.
 
• The temple also serves as a testament to India's rich cultural and artistic heritage.
 
 
 
• **Odissi Dance Revival**
 
 
• Odissi faced a decline during the colonial period but was revived in the mid-20th century by renowned dancers and scholars.
 
• Key figures such as Kelucharan Mohapatra played a significant role in bringing Odissi to the global stage.
 
• Today, Odissi is celebrated as a vibrant and expressive classical dance form across the world.
